title: Team USA Curling: How to Watch the 2026 Winter Olympics Curling Live Online Without Cable for Free
summary: The United States competes for gold in men's and women's curling in Milano Cortina, Italy.
contentText:

With the Winter Olympics in full swing, the United States are one of the top countries with the most medals at 14 (as of this writing). Events are competitive and heated, while curling, a ice and stone competition, has emerged as one of the most popular sports during the winter games.

Curling takes place at the Cortina Curling Olympic Stadium in Cortina d’Ampezzo, Italy. Check out a complete schedule of the event here .

watch 2026 Winter olympics: curling on Peacock

When Does Winter Olympics: Curling Events Start ?

Curling continues until the men’s gold medal final on Saturday, Feb. 21 at 1:05 p.m. ET/10:05 a.m. PT on CNBC, and women’s gold medal final on Sunday, Feb. 22 at 5:05 a.m. ET/2:05 a.m. PT on Peacock . Additionally, you can catch highlights and recaps daily during NBC’s Primetime in Milan coverage starting at 8 p.m. ET/PT.

Men’s and women’s curling are available to watch live and stream on demand. The events broadcast across NBC , USA Network and CNBC, as well as streaming on Peacock .

Peacock

Get Peacock

Can you stream curling on Peacock ? Yes, Peacock goes for $10.99 per month for the Premium plan and $16.99 per month for the Premium Plus plan, both plans include coverage of all Olympic sports.

Outside of the Winter Olympics, Peacock comes with its own collection of original TV shows and movies, as well as programs from NBC, CNBC, USA Network, Bravo and others. TV Shows you can look forward to watching includes Poker Face, The Traitors ,  Couple to Throuple ,  The Best Man: The Final Chapters ,  Bel-Air ,  Love Island, Love Island Games ,  One of Us Is Lying ,  Dr. Death ,  Yellowstone ,  Suits ,  The Office ,  Modern Family and  Parks & Recreation .

The streaming service is also the home to exclusive music programming, such as Girl You Know It’s True , Toby Keith: American Icon , When Metal Ruled the World , America’s Got Talent and others.

Where to Watch the Winter Olympic: Curling Online for Free

If you’re a cord-cutter, then there are a number of ways to watch curling without cable — especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while Hulu + Live TV offers a free trial too. This is a good way to watch NBC, USA Network and CNBC without spending money up front.

Keep reading for more details on how to watch Winter Olympics: Curling on NBC, USA Network and CNBC with DirecTV and Hulu + Live TV and others.

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day Free Trial

The networks NBC, USA Network and CNBC are available to watch with Hulu + Live TV too. Prices for the cable alternative start at $89.99 per month, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost.

Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package. It features many other networks, like CBS, ABC, FOX, BET, CMT, Disney Channel, ESPN, Hallmark Channel and more.

More Ways to Watch

Viewers who want to stream the Winter Olympics internationally can use  ExpressVPN , NordVPN and PureVPN  to access several streaming platforms.

Winter Olympics: Curling broadcasts on NBC, USA Network and CNBC. Peacock and DirecTV are the best ways to watch events.
